purpose: Fixed-code timing characterization following an equivalence smoke, not new candidate tuning or rerunning a consumed namespace. All timing repeats are retained.
timing_scope: Full system.search CPU and wall time including per-request validation, key construction, report copy and cache bookkeeping. Excludes model context initialization, cache installation, outer advance, disk I/O and full Controller/KBM.
warmup_policy: Run and save eight warmup searches once; never count them in the primary measured metric. Each baseline/candidate sequence starts with fresh contexts and caches; retain cache across its two decisions only.
equivalence: All fresh paired actions, Q, visits, states, RNG, transition call counts and outer sampled-geometry details match. Baseline matches saved parent; warmup and measured repeats retained. Any failure stops, no automatic retry.
primary_metric: Ratio of summed candidate system.search time to summed baseline time; report CPU and wall separately, all four blocks and sixteen decision pairs. Never drop slow successful trials.
interpretation: Within-fixed-fixture directional improvement only when CPU and wall are lower in each of all four measured blocks and aggregated, with resource checks and no recorded cgroup throttling. Otherwise retain mixed/non-improving or timing-environment-limited result. No statistical or production speedup claim.
stop_rule: Finish fixed forty calls and freeze regardless of timing outcome. No extra repetitions, changed seeds, cache tuning, or teacher acquisition are authorized.
